purpose.zh: 检查指尖撑墙时，掌根能不能稳稳抬起
purpose.en: Check how well you can lift the heel of your hand with your fingertips on the wall.

text.zh: 指尖贴墙不动，慢慢抬起掌根
text.en: Keep your fingertips on the wall and slowly lift the heel of your hand

text.zh: 面向墙站稳，手臂放松，不耸肩。
text.en: Stand facing the wall, arm relaxed, shoulders down.

text.zh: 抬到能控制的高度停住。
text.en: Stop at the height you can control.

commonErrors.zh: 指尖在墙上滑动或离开墙
commonErrors.en: Letting the fingertips slide or leave the wall.

commonErrors.zh: 用身体前倾代替手腕发力
commonErrors.en: Leaning in instead of moving the wrist.

cautions.zh: 手腕或手指疼时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your wrist or fingers hurt, reduce the range, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画 8 秒 1 次「抬起-停约 3.8 s-放回」在重复，剂量从 1 组 3 秒保持改为 1 组×5 次/侧（rep_hold）
名字「…诊断」太长且书面，改「指尖贴墙抬掌根」；英文同步
flags: 这是检查动作，按次数是否合适（原为保持 3 秒）请定
